'''Tar Jiloma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] with green-gold skin. He had a minor job in the ''[[Conkesta]]'', the secret flying fortress built by [[Karae Nalvas]].<ref name="into" />

Shortly before the ''Conkesta'' was destroyed, Jiloma just bumped into some strangers and questioned them, with one eyebrow raised and one [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] shaking. Jiloma was simply a busybody who wanted to know about the people around him. He was completely unaware that the strangers were undercover raiders on their way to destroy the ''Conkesta''.<ref name="into" />
